name: 08534 · Pennington, NJ
findings: ZIP 08534 (Pennington) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08534 (Pennington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08534 (Pennington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
